description: Na₅TiP₂O₉F crystallizes in the orthorhombic Pbca space group. There are six inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to five O and one F atom to form distorted NaO₅F octahedra that share  a cornercorner with one TiO₅F octahedra, corners with two NaO₆ octahedra, corners with four PO₄ tetrahedra,  a cornercorner with one NaO₄F trigonal bipyramid,  an edgeedge with one NaO₄F trigonal bipyramid,  a faceface with one NaO₅F octahedra, and  a faceface with one TiO₅F octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 45-79°. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.27-2.57 Å. The Na-F bond length is 2.47 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded to four O and one F atom to form distorted NaO₄F trigonal bipyramids that share  a cornercorner with one TiO₅F octahedra, corners with two NaO₅F octahedra, corners with four PO₄ tetrahedra, and edges with three NaO₅F octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 8-84°. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.32-2.37 Å. The Na-F bond length is 2.41 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to five O and one F atom. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.33-2.75 Å. The Na-F bond length is 2.38 Å. In the fourth Na site, Na is bonded to six O atoms to form NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaO₅F octahedra, corners with two equivalent TiO₅F octahedra, corners with four PO₄ tetrahedra, edges with two equivalent NaO₅F octahedra, and edges with two equivalent NaO₄F trigonal bipyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 45-66°. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.38-2.61 Å. In the fifth Na site, Na is bonded to five O and one F atom to form distorted NaO₅F octahedra that share  a cornercorner with one NaO₅F octahedra,  a cornercorner with one TiO₅F octahedra, corners with four PO₄ tetrahedra,  a cornercorner with one NaO₄F trigonal bipyramid,  an edgeedge with one NaO₆ octahedra,  an edgeedge with one NaO₄F trigonal bipyramid,  a faceface with one NaO₅F octahedra, and  a faceface with one TiO₅F octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 70-79°. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.32-2.62 Å. The Na-F bond length is 2.36 Å. In the sixth Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to four O and two equivalent F atoms. There are two shorter (2.42 Å) and two longer (2.66 Å) Na-O bond lengths. Both Na-F bond lengths are 2.29 Å. Ti is bonded to five O and one F atom to form distorted TiO₅F octahedra that share corners with three NaO₅F octahedra, corners with four PO₄ tetrahedra,  a cornercorner with one NaO₄F trigonal bipyramid, and faces with two NaO₅F octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 66-70°. There are a spread of Ti-O bond distances ranging from 1.72-2.06 Å. The Ti-F bond length is 2.26 Å. There are two inequivalent P sites. In the first P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent TiO₅F octahedra, corners with five NaO₅F octahedra, and corners with two equivalent NaO₄F trigonal bipyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 39-67°. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.53-1.58 Å. In the second P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent TiO₅F octahedra, corners with five NaO₅F octahedra, and corners with two equivalent NaO₄F trigonal bipyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 34-65°. There are two shorter (1.53 Å) and two longer (1.58 Å) P-O bond lengths. There are nine inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Ti, and one P atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a rectangular see-saw-like geometry to three Na and one P atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to three Na and one P atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Ti, and one P atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded to three Na and one P atom to form distorted ONa₃P tetrahedra that share corners with three equivalent FNa₅Ti octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 6-69°. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to two Na, one Ti, and one P atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a rectangular see-saw-like geometry to three Na and one P atom. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to two Na, one Ti, and one P atom. In the ninth O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to four Na and one Ti atom. F is bonded to five Na and one Ti atom to form FNa₅Ti octahedra that share  a cornercorner with one FNa₅Ti octahedra and corners with three equivalent ONa₃P tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted.
